claim: Microsoft reports $52.4 billion in gross profit for calendar Q4 2025
summary: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Microsoft's typical late-January report for calendar Q4 2025 (fiscal Q2 FY2026), so the claimed $52.4B gross profit cannot be verified from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft reported results for calendar Q4 2025.
sub_claims.note: As of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04, calendar Q4 2025 had just ended and Microsoft had not yet reported fiscal Q2 FY2026 results.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's gross profit for calendar Q4 2025 was $52.4 billion.
sub_claims.note: No verified gross profit figure for this future period is established in knowledge as of cutoff.
